hero.title: 406 Units Across 36 Buildings, Found in Seconds
hero.body: Dyari Real Estate Development presented its 406-unit Riyadh community at RestateX with a Manzili multi-building twin, exhibition hardware and sales training.

sidebar: Dyari Signature · master-planned residential community of apartments, penthouses and villas (36 buildings, 406 units) · RestateX Diamond Sponsor pavilion
Multi-building WebGL twin · 4K touch tables · Sales team training

challenge.title: Presenting 36 Buildings at a Packed Exhibition
challenge.body: As Diamond Sponsor at RestateX, Dyari expected heavy buyer traffic over four exhibition days. Presenting 406 units across 36 buildings with scale models or printed brochures would have created agent bottlenecks and slowed reservations.
rows: Buyers spend 15+ minutes flipping booklets to find unit types and building numbers.
Sub-second unit filtering: advisors find units by budget, bedrooms, floor and orientation in two taps.
Static plans can't show how buildings relate to gardens, parking and access roads.
3D community twin: shows courtyard views, sun orientation and walkability.
Overloaded venue Wi-Fi stalls cloud-only presentations at peak hours.
Offline-first caching: local hardware keeps running through a full venue outage.

solution.title: A Multi-Building 3D Twin with Instant Unit Search
solution.body: Manzili built one digital twin of all 36 buildings in Dyari Signature, linking large touch tables with overhead LED displays and phone handoffs.

blocks.title: 36-Building Masterplan Navigation
points: One coordinate system allows smooth navigation across all 36 buildings, roads and parks.
Clear zoning shows privacy buffers and vehicle access points.

blocks.title: Instant Unit Search
points: Filters any of the 406 units by layout, floor, area and availability.
Removes manual lookups and speeds up buyer qualification.

blocks.title: Exhibition-Grade Touch Hardware
points: Heavy-duty 4K touch tables paired with synchronized presentation screens.
Waiting visitors watch live walkthroughs while agents present.

blocks.title: QR Code Takeaway
points: Visitors scan a QR code on the touch table to load their shortlisted units on their own phone.
Keeps buyer interest alive without printed brochures.

enablement.title: Fast Qualification for High-Traffic Exhibitions
enablement.body: Manzili trained Dyari's sales team to qualify buyers in 90 seconds and match them to specific units before starting a detailed 3D walkthrough.

steps.title: Multi-Criteria Filtering
steps.body: The agent enters bedrooms, price and preferred building, cutting 406 units to 3 top matches.

steps.title: Community Context
steps.body: The 3D twin then shows building position, courtyard exposure, parking and nearby amenities.

steps.title: Unit Inspection & QR Handover
steps.body: Advisor and buyer review the 3D interior together. Once the buyer is ready to reserve, the unit record goes to their phone by QR code.
